svg.title: Every recorded scenario 1 run, one lane each, in one vocabulary of operations
svg.text: Scenario 1: every recorded run, one lane each
Timed lanes share the axis: seconds from the run's start. Lanes marked "order only" have no times in their records and show their operations as equal steps in order.
Claude Code, isolated like takt's harness
outlined: a takt step taken by the harness (one model call)
dashed: no time recorded, placed in order between timed operations
Data: 2026-10-18 (UTC), docs/metrics/journeys.jsonl from the raw records each run in docs/metrics/scenario-runs.jsonl names. No token or cost figure is read from the journeys.
Free and isolated runs without a stream record only a turn count (Claude Code) or their items in order (Codex); runs with a stream are timed. First results, not a benchmark.
